text:
Good afternoon,

Northgate Supply Co. is hiring a remote Package Inspector for our new home-based program. You will receive packages at your home, inspect them, re-label them with the prepaid labels we email you, and ship them to our overseas clients. Pay is $2,400 per month plus bonuses.

No interview is needed, you can start Monday.

Regards,
Karen Holt
Northgate Supply Co.
hr@northgate-supplyco.com
